query:
SELECT
            o.id     AS "id!",
            c.client_name AS "label!",
            COUNT(*) AS "requests!"
        FROM relay_invocations i
        JOIN oauth_authorizations o ON o.minted_jti = i.minted_jti
        JOIN oauth_clients c ON c.client_id = o.client_id
        WHERE o.user_id = $1
          AND i.created_at >= $2
          AND i.created_at <  $3
        GROUP BY o.id, c.client_name
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 20
